name: 3-in-1 Rechargeable Face & Neck Massager | Red Light Therapy & Microcurrent Anti-Wrinkle Device
description:
The 3-in-1 Rechargeable Face and Neck Massager combines red light therapy, microcurrent technology, and intelligent vibration to lift, tone, and rejuvenate your skin. Designed for anti-wrinkle care, this device improves elasticity, contours the face and neck, and promotes blood circulation. Compact and rechargeable, it’s perfect for daily use at home or on the go.
Key Features
 Red light therapy reduces wrinkles and fine lines
 Microcurrent technology supports lifting and tightening
 Intelligent touch activation for energy efficiency
 Dolphin tail design ensures comfortable grip
 Rechargeable, portable, and easy to use
 Suitable for face, neck, and other body areas
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, Stainless steel, Electronic microcurrent components
How to Use
 Cleanse face and apply serum or moisturizer
 Turn on the device and select preferred mode
 Gently massage face and neck in upward strokes
 Use 5–10 minutes daily for best results
 Recharge via USB cable when needed
Package Includes
 1 × 3-in-1 Face & Neck Massager (Random Color)
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
